name: ezai-project-config
description: Toolchain setup, project configuration, and infrastructure standards for Python and JS/TS projects: pyproject.toml, package.json, linters, Docker, lockfiles, env vars, and observability.

capabilities.description: Initialize or audit a Python project's pyproject.toml
Initialize or audit a JS/TS project's package.json
Configure ruff, ty (Python) or ESLint, tsc (JS/TS)
Write a production-ready multi-stage Dockerfile for Python or Node.js
Set up uv.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, and deterministic CI installs
Configure .env, vault patterns, and secure secret handling
Add OpenTelemetry structured logs and traces
Set up uv (Python) or pnpm workspaces (JS/TS)
Configure pre-commit hooks with lint-staged or husky
